description: Combine two near-misses: E084's bs-1024 32 px phase (+0.18 pp scored, +0.11 pp off-seed, +2.5% time) pays for the first fractional 32 px trim on a Muon base. Base: E084 code (3e30852, samples-indexed _fit, bs 1536 at 16/24 px, bs 1024 at 32 px) with E086's pinned staging buffer ported unchanged. The staging change is math-neutral and was confirmed bit-identical in E086/E087. Change only the length of the 32 px phase, from 4 to 3.75 epochs: 2@16 + 1.25@24 + 3.75@32 px (7.0 ep). The switch is indexed by samples seen. LR warmup/decay, the floor-hold, the final-EMA window, the lookahead stop and the renorm cadence are rescaled by samples, exactly as E084 did. All shapes are already warmed up in build. Precondition, untimed: log the source hash and a diff against 3e30852 plus 749bdce, so the run joins the right family (H4.2.4). Decide with an untimed off-seed run on seeds 3-10 plus two scored runs.
